notes.title: Soundtrack 50% off! & Passing 60 000 downloads.
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

[b]The Flood[/b] has recently passed [b]60 000 downloads[/b].
Big thanks to all the players and everyone who helped out with localizing the game into various languages!

I also wanted to let you know that [b](Soundtrack + Extras) DLC is currently 50% off! [/b]Feel free to get it if you would like to support the development of future games, or if you just like the soundtrack and you would like to get your hands on it. ːsteamhappyː

[b]Also, I'm currently working on a game called[/b] [b]ARTIFICIAL[/b]
You can learn more on my [url=https://twitter.com/OndrejAngelovic]Twitter[/url]
Or get involved by joining our [url=https://discord.gg/SmaUjYH]Discord[/url]

[b]Cheers![/b] ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Italian Localization & Passing 50 000 downloads
notes.content:
[h1]Hey guys![/h1] 

The Flood has passed [b]50 000 downloads [/b]today!
 I'm really happy that so many of you are enjoying the game and it's message.
Thank you for all your support and kind words.

Game now also offers [b]Italian Localization.[/b]
Thanks to Joanna Poznańska for her work!

[h1]I have also started a small discord server[/h1]
Feel free to stop by if you would like to hang out and see what other projects I'm currently working on. [url=https://discord.gg/SmaUjYH]Join Discord[/url]

notes.content:
